description: This file defines backend logic for generating and handling quizzes based on flashcards stored in a database using Supabase. It includes functions for creating quizzes, submitting responses, and retrieving quiz results, managing interactions with related database tables.

methods.name: sample(array, n)
methods.description: Helper to sample 'n' elements from an array without replacement.

methods.name: generateQuiz(userId, { size = 10, categoryId = null, direction = 'en_to_id' })
methods.description: Generates a quiz by selecting a set of flashcards and creating multiple-choice questions, then stores the quiz and attempts in the database.

methods.name: submitQuiz(userId, quizId, { responses })
methods.description: Submits user responses for a specific quiz, updates attempt records, calculates score, and logs review data.

methods.name: quizResults(userId, quizId)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a completed quiz, including all attempt data.

ctags.name: generateQuiz
ctags.pattern: /^async function generateQuiz(userId, { size = 10, categoryId = null, direction = 'en_to_id' }) {$/
